headline: Davos: AI Brag, Greenland, Fake Law

beats.text: At the World Economic Forum in Davos, Trump boasted about AI, promised not to invade Greenland, and invented a law that doesn't exist.

beats.caption: We're leading China by a lot.
beats.label: via The White House

beats.text: PolitiFact only rated that Half True -- the real US lead over China's AI is more like a few months, not "a lot." Rounding up is very on-brand.

beats.caption: I don't have to use force. I don't want to use force. I won't use force.
beats.label: via The White House

beats.text: He says he won't use force to take Greenland, just that America needs it to protect the continent -- which is generally how invasions get their opening statement.

beats.caption: Cap credit card interest rates at 10% for 1 year.
beats.label: via The White House

beats.text: PolitiFact says he'd already claimed on Truth Social that card companies were breaking the law by not doing this -- a law that doesn't exist.
